insights.insight: Students in the bottom 25% for study hours score 9.3% lower than top-quartile studiers.
Students with attendance below 90% perform 5.9% worse than those above 95% attendance.
Students with low wellness scores (≤2, sleep proxy) perform 6.0% worse than high-wellness peers (≥4).
insights.note: UCI dataset uses health score 1–5 as wellness/sleep proxy.

insights.insight: Mathematics is the weakest subject (avg 52.0%), 7.5 points below Portuguese.
51% of students are at-risk (performance below 60%). Prioritize revision on weak subjects and attendance coaching.
